Subject: Request: provisioning plan for OptiRetail assessment kit

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week—OptiRetail is excited to move the MAP forward. To complete our internal security and acceptance gating we need the following from Redwood:

- A Mutual Action Plan (high level milestones + owners) showing dataset/promptpack provisioning, staged access, and final close date.
- Evaluation artifacts: sample prompt pack (scoped), a small representative test set (~2k records) and instructions for sandbox ingestion.
- Usage constraints: retention window, allowed sharing, and destruction requirements after the trial.

I've attached the signed NDA for your records. Can you confirm whether Redwood will host the sandbox or provide an ephemeral download?

Target timeline from OptiRetail: provisioning by Jun 11, staged evaluation June 14–25, final decision by Jun 30. If that doesn't match your timelines, propose alternatives.

Appreciate it—cc'ing Nina (evaluation lead).

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz

OptiRetail

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear ask and for the NDA. We're aligned on the approach and can support an ephemeral sandbox plus limited downloadable artifacts for internal review (encrypted archive + license). Below is a proposed MAP and the controls we enforce on exchanged materials.

SUMMARY (high level)
- Jun 4: MPA + instructions shared (Redwood sends Drive link + licensing terms).
- Jun 8: Sample prompt pack & 500-record staging set (ephemeral download) delivered.
- Jun 11: Sandbox provisioning (hosted by Redwood in us-west region; access via short-lived tokens).
- Jun 14–25: Evaluation window (OptiRetail runs acceptance tests; Redwood on-call).
- Jun 26: Regression/issue triage; final notes due Jun 28.
- Jun 30: Close decision/next steps.

USAGE CONSTRAINTS (short)
- Retention: Redwood retains sample artifacts for 30 days post-provisioning unless OptiRetail requests earlier destruction.
- Sharing: Files may not be redistributed outside OptiRetail evaluation team.
- Derivatives: No commercial use or public release of promptpack-derived models; samples used for benchmarking only.
- Audit: Access logs are available on request; we will provide a simple audit extract after the evaluation period.

ATTACHMENTS & LINKS
- redwood-eval-instructions.pdf (checklist + ingestion steps) — Drive link will be shared after signature on the MPA.
- sample-promptpack-license.txt (one-page license excerpt).

NEXT STEPS
1) If OptiRetail agrees to the constraints above, we'll circulate a short MPA PDF and a DocuSign for the licensing addendum.
2) Marissa will provision the staging bundle once signatures are in.
3) Karthik will be on the security/compliance thread to confirm encryption and token lifetimes.

If the timeline you listed (provision by Jun 11) is firm, we can hit it assuming signatures are returned by EOD Jun 4.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
